exposure: oral administration of 40% dextrose gel at 30 minutes of life
oral administration of 40% dextrose gel at 60 minutes of life
cohort: Participants were at-risk newborns born by vaginal or Caesarean section who received 40% oral dextrose gel at either 30 or 60 minutes after birth.
finding: The timing of 40% oral dextrose gel administration (30 vs. 60 min) did not significantly influence the incidence of hypoglycemia in at-risk infants.
mod_finding: Newborns born by Caesarean section who received 40% oral dextrose gel at 30 minutes of life consumed more formula milk compared to other groups.
